ECITT – standalone

Single-device version of the Early Childhood Inhibitory Touchscreen Task (Holmboe et al., 2021)

Before handing over the iPad: volume up, Guided Access on (triple-click the top/home button), landscape orientation.
During the task, press and hold the top-left corner for 3 s to stop and open the results screen.

Press and hold to begin
Repeat practice
Please rotate the iPad to landscape
Experimenter: hold

Session finished

Accuracy and RT are based on the first press of each test trial. RT is measured from the moment the buttons appeared. Full press-level data is in the CSV.
